content.title: Pliant halts bexotegrast development for IPF after trial results
content.summary: The decision was influenced by the analysis involving 160mg and 320mg doses of the therapy, indicating an unfavourable risk-benefit profile.

thumbnail.caption: Pliant plans to submit the full outcomes from the BEACON-IPF trial for future publication. Credit: Lana Leon/Shutterstock.

content.title: Pliant cuts workforce by 45% following lung trial termination
content.summary: Pliant is slashing 45% of its workforce in a move to “minimise costs and preserve cash reserves”.

thumbnail.caption: The layoffs are expected to affect all departments. Credit: Andrii Yalanskyi via Getty Images.

content.title: Cytokinetics reveals unexpected delay; AstraZeneca combo therapy hits in asthma
content.summary: The FDA pushed back its decision date on Cytokinetics’ heart drug. Elsewhere, Repare Therapeutics licensed its drug discovery work, intellectual property and certain other assets into a newly launched startup.

content.title: PLIANT THERAPT (PLRX) Upgraded to Buy: Here's What You Should Know
content.summary: PLIANT THERAPT (PLRX) has been upgraded to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), reflecting growing optimism about the company's earnings prospects. This might drive the stock higher in the near term.

content.title: PLRX Stock Plunges 89% in 3 Months: Here's What Investors Should Know
content.summary: Pliant stock crashes 89% in three months following setbacks in the mid-stage study of its lead candidate, bexotegrast, for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

content.title: Makary advances to full senate vote; Acelyrin, Pliant adopt ‘poison pills’
content.summary: President Trump’s nominee to run the FDA secured the Senate HELP Committee’s backing. Elsewhere, Sutro cut jobs and a cell and gene therapy pilot appeared to survive.

content.title: Pliant Therapeutics stock tumbles amid IPF trial cancellation
content.summary: The company’s stock price has dropped to around $1.38 per share after its IPF therapy trial was stopped for safety.

content.title: Neumora bids farewell to R&D head; Biohaven’s ‘one step forward, one step back’ data
content.summary: Robert Lenz is leaving the brain drug developer to “pursue other interests.” Elsewhere, Atara is cutting half of its staff after shelving two cell therapy programs.
